image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a small puppy, identified as a Blenheim Spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel type), standing on a weathered wooden deck. The dog has a white coat with rich chestnut/red patches on its ears and around the eyes. It is looking directly up at the camera with large, dark, expressive eyes. The lighting is bright sunlight, casting strong shadows on the wood planks.
